ops.body: Small release-config followup for final cc-sync merge: .goreleaser.yaml:18 still declares goos: [darwin, linux], although the reproduced CI failure established the dependencies only compile for darwin and ci.yml now reflects that. Align the release target with actual supported platform (darwin) and run goreleaser config validation/build where available; otherwise first release will retry the known-failing Linux build. No Linux port is requested.
